+@pytest.mark.parametrize('command, roles, collections, warning, verbose', [
+    (['install'], True, True, False, False),
+    (['install', '-p', '/tmp/galaxy-roles'], True, False, True, False),
+    (['role', 'install'], True, False, False, True),
+    (['collection', 'install'], False, True, False, False),
+])
+def test_mixed_requirements_install(reset_cli_args, tmp_path, monkeypatch, command, roles, collections, warning, verbose):
+    requirements_file = str(tmp_path / 'requirements.yml')
+    (tmp_path / 'requirements.yml').write_text('roles: []\ncollections: []\n')
+    parsed = {'roles': [MagicMock(name='role')], 'collections': [('namespace.collection', '*', None)]}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_parse_requirements_file', MagicMock(return_value=parsed))
+    role_install = MagicMock()
+    collection_install = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_install_roles', role_install)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_install_collections', collection_install)
+    mock_warning = MagicMock()
+    mock_verbose = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ansible.utils.display.Display, 'warning', mock_warning)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ansible.utils.display.Display, 'vvv', mock_verbose)
+
+    GalaxyCLI(['ansible-galaxy'] + command + ['-r', requirements_file]).run()
+
+    assert bool(role_install.call_count) == roles
+    assert bool(collection_install.call_count) == collections
+    if warning:
+        assert 'Collections cannot be installed to a roles path' in mock_warning.call_args[0][0]
+    if verbose:
+        assert 'contains collections which will be ignored' in mock_verbose.call_args[0][0]
+
+
+def test_empty_requirements_skip_install(reset_cli_args, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
+    requirements_file = str(tmp_path / 'requirements.yml')
+    (tmp_path / 'requirements.yml').write_text('roles: []\ncollections: []\n')
+    role_install = MagicMock()
+    collection_install = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_install_roles', role_install)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_install_collections', collection_install)
+
+    GalaxyCLI(['ansible-galaxy', 'install', '-r', requirements_file]).run()
+
+    assert 'Skipping install, no requirements found' in capsys.readouterr().out
+    role_install.assert_not_called()
+    collection_install.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_selected_role_installs_transitive_dependency(reset_cli_args, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    requirements_file = str(tmp_path / 'requirements.yml')
+    root = MagicMock(name='root')
+    root.name = 'root'
+    root.install_info = None
+    root.install.return_value = True
+    root.metadata = {'dependencies': ['namespace.dep']}
+    root.requirements = []
+    dependency = MagicMock(name='dependency')
+    dependency.name = dependency.src = 'namespace.dep'
+    dependency.scm = None
+    dependency.install_info = None
+    dependency.install.return_value = True
+    dependency.metadata = {}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_parse_requirements_file', MagicMock(return_value={
+        'roles': [root], 'collections': [],
+    }))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ansible.cli.galaxy, 'GalaxyRole', MagicMock(return_value=dependency))
+
+    GalaxyCLI(['ansible-galaxy', 'role', 'install', '-r', requirements_file, 'root']).run()
+
+    root.install.assert_called_once_with()
+    dependency.install.assert_called_once_with()
+
